operations.name: Kris Selvig

expected.charges: Contempt of court for violating an injunction against trespass at Rocky Flats.
expected.sentence: Pretrial detention: jailed from December 25, 1981 and remanded again January 8, 1982 after declining bond. March 1 trial scheduled. Final disposition and release date not established by this issue.

updates.convicted: Convicted March 1, 1982 of violating the federal injunction against trespassing at Rocky Flats.

operations.source: National No-Nukes Prison Support Collective newsletter, April 15, 1982, page3. https://media.nukeresister.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/NR011_19820415small.pdf#page=3
